text: 1. 1f the preference is an Environment preference,tcserver checks the value of the 0S environment variable of the same name. If the environment variable exists,the value returned and cached for future requests. 2. 1f the preference is not an Environment preference, or if there was no 0S value present, tcserver looks for a preference instance at the User location for the current user. If it is found, it returns the value. 3. 1f tcserver has not returned a preference value yet, it looks for a preference instance at the Role location for the user 「s current role. If it is found, it returns the value. 4. If toserver has not returned a preference value yet, it looks for a preference instance at the Group location for the user's current group. If it is found, it returns the value. 5. 1f tcserver has not returned a preference value yet, it returns the value of the preference instance at the Site / System location.
